approved_payload.content: Mitchells Plain police were called to the corner of Hugenot Street and AZ Berman Drive, Tafelsig, where a body was found burning; it was burned beyond recognition, a murder case was registered and a post-mortem will identify the deceased (EWN, quoting police spokesperson FC van Wyk). EWN later reported it as a woman's body found on Saturday 17 October.
